name: select
description: The single-select primitive: a native <select> with the themed look and a decorative chevron. Native on purpose — the OS renders the option list, so it works on touch, with the keyboard and with screen readers out of the box. Pass <option>s as children and pair with field. For an async type-ahead picker use async-combobox; for several values, multi-select.

notes: A native <select>, so the listbox, keyboard navigation and announcements are the platform's — accessible with no ARIA wiring
The chevron is aria-hidden and never intercepts pointer events
Give it a label via field or htmlFor; reflects aria-invalid visually and shows a focus-visible ring

intents: choose one option from a short fixed list
the control inside a field wrapper for a single choice
